capacity_factor_basis.Utility solar: MBIE 2024-25 generation divided by average start/end-year installed capacity; pooled two-year factor.
capacity_factor_basis.Onshore wind: MBIE 2024-25 generation divided by average start/end-year installed capacity; pooled two-year factor.
capacity_factor_basis.Geothermal: MBIE 2024-25 generation divided by average start/end-year installed capacity; pooled two-year factor.
capacity_factor_basis.Hydro: 50% annual-energy approximation, close to recent NZ hydro fleet utilisation; hydro energy remains hydrology constrained.
capacity_factor_basis.Offshore wind: 45% conservative planning assumption because New Zealand has no operating offshore-wind fleet.
capacity_factor_basis.Gas: 15% illustrative utilisation for prospective thermal capacity, not an energy availability assumption.

project_specific_generation_note: The retained EA pipeline snapshot is aggregated by status, technology and commissioning year and does not expose project identity or published annual MWh. If a future source provides published_annual_generation_gwh or annual_generation_gwh, this renderer automatically prefers that value over the technology capacity-factor fallback.
